text_block_list.text:
Failing to claim 1st place in the Japanese 
Derby, King Halo bit her lip in deep 
disappointment. Though she tried to put on 
a brave face for her Trainer...

Just then, a phone call came from her 
mother. While praising Special Week's run, 
she urged King Halo to simply give up.

"I recommend coming home before you make a 
greater fool of yourself." Tearing up at 
her mother's words, King Halo makes a 
solemn vow.

She vowed to win the Kikuka Sho, the final 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown route, 
without yielding first place to anyone. 
—To prove she is an Umamusume deserving of 
recognition.
